title: The Inflating Cost of Intelligence
author: Tomasz Tunguz
summary:
For three years, the story of LLM pricing was simple: prices kept falling. GPT-4o crushed GPT-4’s listed price by 8x. Gemini 1.5 Flash undercut everyone at $0.075/million input tokens. Looking at the full dataset of flagship model releases from early 2023 through May 2026, the trend flips: prices dropped for ~2.5 years, then turned sharply upward. Each of the three provider families now shows the same hump-shaped curve: decline, then reversal.

I'm sure we didn't catch 100% of LLM-assisted PRs over the past few months, but the kind of mistakes humans make are fundamentally different than LLM hallucinations, making them easy to spot.
